{{Top|leg}}
A '''magnetic grappler''' was a device that [[Jodo Kast]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] had equipped on their [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]]. Kast once used his to destroy a ceiling and escape.
